title: torus
body:
## torus

Creates a native Part::Torus: a circular tube of radius minorRadius swept around a circular path of radius majorRadius, centred at origin in the plane perpendicular to axis. Choose it for O-rings, handles and ring groove tools (cut a torus from a shaft). Schemaxis requires minorRadius < majorRadius, so the ring always has a central hole.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- minorRadius equal to or larger than majorRadius fails planning with INVALID_GEOMETRY.
- Covered by the analytic-volume acceptance fixture (2·π²·R·r²); not exhaustively qualified.

Native binding: `Part::Torus`. Output kind: `["solid"]`.

Inputs: none.

| Option | Meaning | Type / constraints | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `majorRadius` | Distance from the torus centre to the centre of the tube cross-section, in millimetres (FreeCAD Radius1). The outer diameter is 2 × (majorRadius + minorRadius) and the hole diameter 2 × (majorRadius − minorRadius). | `{"type":"number","minimum":0,"exclusiveMinimum":true,"maximum":100000}` | `20` |
| `minorRadius` | Radius of the circular tube cross-section, in millimetres (FreeCAD Radius2); the ring is 2 × minorRadius thick. | `{"type":"number","minimum":0,"exclusiveMinimum":true,"maximum":100000}` | `5` |
| `origin` | World coordinates [x, y, z] of the torus centre, the centre of its circular path. | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"number"},"minItems":3,"maxItems":3}` | `[0,0,0]` |
| `axis` | World direction of the ring's axis of symmetry, through the hole and perpendicular to the plane of the circular path. Magnitude is ignored. | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"number"},"minItems":3,"maxItems":3}` | `[0,0,1]` |
